### Reconstruction

**Outcome:** not reproduced.

**Comparison basis:** Conditional diagnostic, not the original EosFit-7c objective: the source does not specify its numerical weights, covariance, iteration settings, or handling of blank/zero coordinate errors. Printed errors are provisionally treated as standard deviations solely for this diagnostic. Published coefficients remain unchanged. Thermal V0=22.81 A^3 follows Section 3.3; Table 1 instead gives 22.80(2) A^3 and the printed molar value converts to 22.81581 A^3. This diagnostic fixes V0 even though the author clarified that V0 was free in the final stage. See literature-reproductions/miozzi-2020-iron.md.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Experimental DAC diffraction P-V-T fits; theta0=420 K is adopted and fixed. Measured low-pressure helium observations constrain the extrapolated hcp reference volume.
- **Equation:** BM3 Equation (3), or current-study Vinet alternative in Table 1; thermal Equations (4), (6), (8) use integrated Gruneisen MGD. Equation (5) has gamma instead of V in its denominator and a comma instead of subtraction; Equation (7) omits the cube on T/theta and prints theta0/T as integration limit although theta is volume-dependent. Standard vibrational MGD mapping is explicit and remains unvalidated against the authors’ fit.
- **V0:** Table 1: BM3 22.80(2) A^3, Vinet 22.81 A^3 (no error). Section 3.3: thermal 6.87(2) cm^3/mol of Fe, parenthetically 22.81 A^3. Preserve the printed cell central value; convert the molar uncertainty to the Z=2 cell. The central molar number converts to 22.815807 A^3, and Section 3.3 says V0 was fixed at the room-temperature value.
- **K0:** Table 1 for isothermal records; Section 3.3 for final thermal 129(1) GPa.
- **K0 prime:** Table 1 for isothermal records; Section 3.3 for final thermal 6.24(4).
- **Volume basis:** Equation (3) and dataset headings specify the conventional hcp unit cell with two Fe atoms. Thermal energy is per mole of Fe atoms (n=1); molar cm^3/mol = V\_cell\*N\_A/(2e24).
- **Uncertainties:** Parenthesized reported errors, unspecified confidence; missing Vinet V0 error is null. Fixed thermal V0 retains independent reference-volume error. No author covariance.

</details>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Experimental DAC diffraction P-V-T fits; theta0=420 K is adopted and fixed. Measured low-pressure helium observations constrain the extrapolated hcp reference volume.
- **Equation:** BM3 Equation (3), thermal Equations (4), (6), (8) with integrated Gruneisen MGD. Apparent Equation (5) denominator/subtraction and Equation (7) Debye-integral typesetting defects are mapped explicitly to gamma\*delta(E\_D)/V\_molar. Full MGD and n=2 at the per-mole-Fe volume are author-confirmed by the recorded personal communication.
- **V0:** Table 1: BM3 22.80(2) A^3, Vinet 22.81 A^3 (no error). Section 3.3: thermal 6.87(2) cm^3/mol of Fe, parenthetically 22.81 A^3. Preserve the printed cell central value; convert the molar uncertainty to the Z=2 cell. The central molar number converts to 22.815807 A^3, and Section 3.3 says V0 was fixed at the room-temperature value. Figure 4 inset instead repeats V0=22.80(2) A^3; the represented thermal central value follows the Section 3.3 prose explicitly. Personal communication recorded 2026-10-03 clarifies that V0 was free in the final stage; the article's fixed-V0 wording remains a documented source discrepancy. The printed coefficient is retained.
- **K0:** Table 1 for isothermal records; Section 3.3 for final thermal 129(1) GPa.
- **K0 prime:** Table 1 for isothermal records; Section 3.3 for final thermal 6.24(4).
- **Volume basis:** Public conventional hcp cell contains two Fe atoms; internal molar volume is V\_cell\*N\_A/(2e24) cm3/mol (~6.87 at V0), with author-reported n=2. n is not silently normalized to 1 or accompanied by a volume doubling.
- **Uncertainties:** Parenthesized published errors, unspecified confidence; reference volume error converted from the printed molar error. No author covariance.

Local errors/covariance are conditional on this calibration, objective and fixed parameters, excluding calibrant systematics, predictor and inter-row covariance and fixed-theta uncertainty. Original author weights and exact pressure reduction remain unavailable; numerical reproducibility does not establish independent physical accuracy.

Parameter covariance is supplied in the complete EOSMAT source.
